title: NestJS + Fastify Fundamentals
outcome: Build a NestJS 12 API on Fastify and understand modules, controllers, providers, dependency injection, configuration, and request lifecycle.
artifact: A modular API with health endpoint and a small feature module whose controller and service responsibilities are separate.
labSteps: Generate the API workspace and replace the default HTTP adapter with Fastify deliberately.
Create a HealthModule with controller and service instead of putting everything in AppController.
Inject the service through the constructor and explain how Nest resolves it.
Add configuration through Nest Config rather than reading process.env everywhere.
Trace one request with logs through bootstrap, controller, and service.
Break provider registration intentionally, read the dependency-resolution error, and repair the module graph.
failureModes: Adapter-specific plugins assumed to work like Express middleware
mastery: Can create a feature module from scratch
Can distinguish adapter and framework responsibilities
Can debug a dependency injection error
principles: Controllers translate HTTP concerns; services own application behavior and orchestration.
Dependency injection makes dependencies explicit and replaceable instead of hiding them in global imports.
Use Fastify as the HTTP adapter without leaking adapter-specific details through the entire application.
Organize NestJS modules around cohesive features rather than one giant application module.
